Write an infographic text about chameleons. Use the notes to help you. Write about its habitat, characteristics, diet and behaviour.

Chameleon
- Habitat: mainly rainforests, deserts (Africa)
- Diet: grasshoppers and stick insects
- Characteristics: big eyes, 360-degree view, crested head
- Behaviour: Uses tongue to catch prey

tu_kiem.t: Có đủ bốn mục: habitat, characteristics, diet, behaviour.
Dùng present simple đúng: chủ ngữ số ít thêm s (a chameleon lives…), chủ ngữ số nhiều không thêm s.
Câu ngắn, gọn như infographic (short sentences), chỉ giữ ý chính (key words).
Có ít nhất một defining relative clause (vd …which it uses to catch prey).
Dài khoảng 40–100 từ.

b.0670df64.de:
Write an infographic text about a carnivorous plant. Choose ONE plant and use the facts on its card. Write about its habitat, its diet and how it catches its food.

🪤 Venus flytrap
- Habitat: wet, sunny places in North and South Carolina (USA)
- Grows in poor soil with few nutrients
- Diet: ants, flies, spiders and beetles
- Has tiny trigger hairs inside each leaf
- The leaf snaps shut when an insect touches the hairs twice
- Digests an insect in about one week

🏺 Pitcher plant
- Habitat: hot, wet rainforests in Southeast Asia
- Leaves grow into a deep cup called a pitcher
- Sweet nectar around the top attracts insects
- The edge is very slippery, so insects fall in
- Liquid at the bottom digests the prey
- Some very big pitchers can trap small frogs

tu_kiem.t: Chọn MỘT plant và dùng ít nhất 3 dữ kiện trong thẻ của nó (habitat, diet, cách bắt mồi).
Present simple đúng: chủ ngữ số ít thêm s (a pitcher plant grows…), chủ ngữ số nhiều không thêm s.
Có ít nhất một câu passive is / are + V3 (vd Insects are trapped by the leaves).
Có ít nhất một relative clause với which, that hoặc whose.
Dài khoảng 60–120 từ.

b.1523ad15.de:
Choose a collective noun phrase and write a passage of 200 words about it. You can use these facts to support your writing.

🐻 Polar Bear
- Living place: the Arctic
- Thick white fur to stay warm and hide in snow
- Carnivore — mainly eats seals
- Great swimmers — can swim for hours
- Has black skin under its fur to absorb heat
- Apex predator in its food chain

🐋 Sperm Whale
- Living space: deep oceans around the world
- Largest toothed predator on Earth
- Can dive over 1,000 meters to hunt
- Eats giant squid and fish
- Has a big head filled with waxy oil (helps with deep diving)
- Can find food in darkness

🐧 Penguin
- Lives in the Antarctic
- Cannot fly
- Carnivore — fish, krill, and squid
- Huddles together to keep warm
- Lays eggs on land or ice
- Both parents take care of the chick
- Black-and-white skin for camouflage in water

tu_kiem.t: Có một collective noun phrase (vd a pod of whales) và cả bài xoay quanh nó.
Dùng ít nhất 3 dữ kiện trong các thẻ Polar Bear / Sperm Whale / Penguin.
Present simple đúng: chủ ngữ số ít thêm s, chủ ngữ số nhiều không thêm s.
Collective noun phrase làm chủ ngữ thì đi với động từ số ít (A pod of whales swims…).
Dài khoảng 200 từ (150–250 từ).

b.c06b98a4.de:
Choose a collective noun phrase and write a passage of 200 words about it. You can use these facts to support your writing.

🦁 Lion
- Living place: grasslands (savanna) of Africa
- Carnivore — hunts zebras, antelopes and buffalo
- Female lions do most of the hunting, often as a team
- Male lions have a thick mane around the head
- Sleeps or rests up to 20 hours a day
- Its roar can be heard about 8 kilometres away

🐘 African Elephant
- Living place: grasslands and forests of Africa
- Largest land animal on Earth
- Herbivore — eats grass, leaves, fruit and bark
- Uses its trunk to drink, smell and pick up food
- Flaps its big ears to keep cool
- The oldest female leads the group

🐝 Honeybee
- Lives in a hive with thousands of other bees
- Only the queen bee lays eggs
- Worker bees collect nectar and pollen from flowers
- Does a 'waggle dance' to show other bees where flowers are
- Makes honey to eat in winter
- Carries pollen from flower to flower, which helps plants grow fruit

tu_kiem.t: Có một collective noun phrase (vd a pride of lions) và cả bài xoay quanh nó.
Dùng ít nhất 3 dữ kiện trong các thẻ Lion / African Elephant / Honeybee.
Present simple đúng: chủ ngữ số ít thêm s, chủ ngữ số nhiều không thêm s.
Collective noun phrase làm chủ ngữ thì đi với động từ số ít (A pride of lions lives…).
Dài khoảng 200 từ (150–250 từ).

b.e02e8b71.de:
Choose a collective noun phrase and write a passage of 200 words about it. You can use these facts to support your writing.

🐬 Bottlenose Dolphin
- Living place: warm seas and oceans around the world
- A mammal — breathes air through a blowhole on its head
- Carnivore — eats fish, squid and shrimp
- Uses clicks and echoes (echolocation) to find food
- Very clever — can learn tricks and solve problems
- Mothers look after their calves for about 3 years

🐺 Grey Wolf
- Living place: forests, mountains and the tundra of North America, Europe and Asia
- Carnivore — hunts deer, elk and moose
- Hunts as a team to catch animals bigger than itself
- Howls to talk to other wolves far away
- Thick fur keeps it warm in snowy winters
- Parents lead the group and teach the pups

🦓 Zebra
- Living place: grasslands (savanna) of Africa
- Herbivore — mainly eats grass
- Every zebra has its own pattern of black-and-white stripes
- Stripes may confuse lions when many zebras run together
- Can run up to about 65 km per hour
- Stays in a group to be safe from predators

tu_kiem.t: Có một collective noun phrase (vd a pack of wolves) và cả bài xoay quanh nó.
Dùng ít nhất 3 dữ kiện trong các thẻ Bottlenose Dolphin / Grey Wolf / Zebra.
Present simple đúng: chủ ngữ số ít thêm s, chủ ngữ số nhiều không thêm s.
Collective noun phrase làm chủ ngữ thì đi với động từ số ít (A herd of zebras runs…).
Dài khoảng 200 từ (150–250 từ).
